reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
This week, this app has become my least favorite app for listening to the Quran. I’ve been using it for a long time, and I’m extremely disappointed that a basic feature like “Repeat” is now being placed behind a subscription.

I use the repeat feature specifically when I’m learning a Surah. I select the Surah I want to learn, turn on repeat, and listen while I’m doing other things so I don’t have to keep touching my phone and restarting it. Yesterday, I tried to do exactly that and discovered that I’m now being asked to pay to use a feature I’ve been using before.

Adding a subscription for additional premium features is one thing, but taking an existing basic feature like “Repeat” and requiring users to pay for it is extremely frustrating. I’m not paying a subscription just to repeat a Surah.

I use Repeat One while I’m at work because I choose one Surah that I’m trying to learn and listen to it over and over without having to touch my phone. I also sleep while listening to the Quran and use repeat so the recitation continues. Now I can’t even do that without being asked to subscribe. These aren’t luxury features to me, they’re basic functions I’ve been using for a long time.

Please bring the free Repeat feature back. Turning previously accessible features into paid features does not make me want to subscribe, it makes me want to find another Quran app.

reviews.title: اتقوا الله
reviews.text:
Salam,

How will you answer to Allah that people were forced to see haram ads during fasting in Ramadan because you wished to make some extra money this month? 

I am by all means not perfect and will have to answer to Allah for my sins, but how will you stand in front of Allah and answer Him on why you forced people in Ramadan to watch ads even after they paid you to remove the ads? 

I know you have removed the restore purchase option to maximize revenue during Ramadan from ads. Understandable, it costs money to run these apps. My question is have you made enough money yet? 

Where is the honor in running such an amazing app if you can’t even honor the restore purchase option for people who have already paid? 

I write this with tears because again I am not perfect by any means. But I fear for His punishment when I do not honor my promises. 

I pray the greed from making money doesn’t blind you and changes your heart to fix the app.

 InshaAllah I will pray that you honor your promise of no ads for lifetime users. Again I am not perfect and I ask you make dua that I can improve in my deen.

Awaiting your response,

Taha Hafeez
